Le soir, on s'assoit en rond et quelqu'u: In the evening, people sit in a circle and someone tells a story. It was around this fire that the island started talking to itself.
Des maîtres y apprennent, contre paiemen: Masters teach there, for a fee, how to argue for and then against. Parents are wary, and enroll their children anyway.
Qui monte dessus a le droit de parler à: Whoever stands on it has the right to speak to the whole assembly. The island's decisions are made within earshot of it.
La classe des trois preuves: The class of the three proofs
Qui parle, à qui, avec quels arguments :: Who is speaking, to whom, with what arguments: a speech is taken apart there like a clock. The island's pleaders practice their scales there.
On y apprend à présenter une idée à quel: Here you learn to present an idea to someone who can say no. Neighbourhood projects save a huge amount of time here.
Un accusé, un avocat, des jurés. La caus: A defendant, a lawyer, jurors. The best-pleaded case is not always the fairest one, and the jurors learn that too.
On y débat selon des règles : une thèse,: Debates here follow rules: a thesis, a reason, an example. Whoever loses their temper has lost.
Dès l'enfance, on y apprend à lire à voi: From childhood, you learn here to read aloud and to stand up in front of others. The island's shy folk lose their stage fright here.
Un étudiant défend, un autre attaque, le: One student defends, another attacks, the master decides. You come out with sharper ideas and a hoarse voice.
On y pèse chaque mot pour sa justesse et: Every word is weighed here for its accuracy and its brilliance. The island's love letters have improved markedly.
Sous ses branches, une voix garde l'hist: Under its branches, a voice keeps the history of every family. No birth and no promise is ever lost there.
Des caractères de plomb, une presse, et: Lead type, a press, and a hundred copies before noon. An idea launched in the morning has gone round the island by evening.
Deux thèses, un jury, des heures de jout: Two theses, a jury, hours of jousting. Questions that had riled the island for years were settled here.
Le peintre y trouve la formule qui reste: The painter finds here, for every shop, the slogan that sticks in your head. "Bread, that's all" still makes the baker laugh.
On y épingle au mur les arguments tordus: The twisted arguments heard at the market are pinned to the wall here, with their names. Smooth talkers give it a wide berth.
Une estrade de bois d'où l'on défend ceu: A wooden platform from which you defend those nobody listens to. More than one injustice on the island has ended here.
Tout le monde peut y coller, et une équi: Anyone can stick things up, and a team flags the posters that lie. You learn here to spot the refrain.
Un micro, une lampe rouge, et une voix q: A microphone, a red lamp, and a voice that enters every home. On great evenings, the island falls silent to listen.
Un héros, un obstacle, un retournement :: A hero, an obstacle, a twist: the island's authors know the tricks, and the audience cries anyway.
On y présente d'abord la meilleure versi: Here you first present the best version of the opposing view, then you reply. Votes are slower here, and better.
